statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete: all 58 checks judged across six representative paths. No local target config was loaded.

page.framework: server-rendered MPA with client-side advertising, consent, PWA service worker, and utility widgets
page.notes: Representative coverage includes home, listing, article, rates, calculator, and error state. Excluded duplicate locale/city/rate pages and account-only surfaces because they reuse covered templates or are not required for the public core journeys.

checkOutcomes.method: Dark-media screenshot and computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark preference matched and the body rendered rgb(10,14,18), showing a dark surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion and queried document animations
checkOutcomes.evidence: A 38,000 ms animation remained running under reduce.

checkOutcomes.method: Stylesheet signals plus axe contrast analysis
checkOutcomes.evidence: No prefers-contrast/forced-colors rules were found and axe reported contrast failures.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected live CSS across representative MPA states
checkOutcomes.evidence: No View Transition CSS was present on route-rich and stateful surfaces.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS animation signals and trace long tasks
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-linked visual animation was present that used a main-thread scroll handler; no trace long tasks were recorded.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected gesture-related CSS
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSS uses scroll-snap, providing platform-native physical scrolling behavior; screenshots showed no pointer-only custom gesture dependency.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected long article screenshot and stylesheet signals
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-state/progress treatment was found on a long article.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected overlay/menu primitives and CSS signals
checkOutcomes.evidence: Overlay/menu UI exists but no anchor positioning or native popover treatment was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed representative screenshots and navigation CSS signals
checkOutcomes.evidence: No progress marker, transition, or highlight guides attention through long content.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured page-load screenshots across five archetypes
checkOutcomes.evidence: A consent interstitial obscured every tested primary surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Queried dialog, popover, and overlay elements
checkOutcomes.evidence: Four custom DIV role=dialog overlays were present; no native dialog/popover primitive was used.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed mobile and desktop screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dense double-row navigation, ads, and repeated widgets compete with core content.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured mobile screenshots and layout metrics at 360x800
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport meta was absent and Chrome used a 980-1003px layout viewport scaled to 360px.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected live stylesheet rules
checkOutcomes.evidence: No @container or container-type rules were found for reused cards/widgets.

checkOutcomes.method: Focused visible links/buttons and inspected computed outline
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary links and icon buttons had outline-style none and no focus box-shadow.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first-view screenshots and headings across templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, News, article, Gold Rates, and Gold Calculator surfaces communicate their purpose with visible headings/content.

checkOutcomes.method: Walked listing-to-article and calculator control surfaces
checkOutcomes.evidence: A news item opens its complete article and calculator controls produce an immediate total without account gating.

checkOutcomes.method: Exercised empty calculator input and nonexistent URL
checkOutcomes.evidence: Empty weight silently yielded ₹0 with no validation; unknown URL offered no intentional recovery state.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse and DevTools trace
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse LCP was 13.9s and TTI 17.0s; CLS was good.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured CLS with layout observer and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: Layout observer measured CLS 0.0008 and Lighthouse measured 0.026, both good.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse TBT plus script/network analysis
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse TBT was 210ms and the page loaded 47 scripts, with large avoidable third-party execution.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and confirmed candidate script attributes in DOM
checkOutcomes.evidence: 183 requests transferred 3.05MB; 152 requests and 2.70MB were third-party.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse code diagnostics and HAR
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 570KiB unused JavaScript and showed three separate Google tag scripts.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran axe-core on home and calculator plus image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Axe found unnamed buttons/links on both templates; image audit found 11 missing alt attributes.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran axe-core contrast checks
checkOutcomes.evidence: Axe found contrast violations on consent UI and calculator controls.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran axe structure rules and active focus-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Heading/landmark violations and invisible focus were directly observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually inspected article and calculator at representative viewport
checkOutcomes.evidence: Core article paragraphs and calculator explanations remain readable with stable line spacing; no clipping was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected viewport/reflow at 360x800 and Lighthouse responsive behavior
checkOutcomes.evidence: Missing viewport meta forces scaled desktop rendering and harms zoom/reflow usability.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse errors-in-console audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console audit passed with no items.

checkOutcomes.method: Probed doctype/charset and audited all images
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype/UTF-8 passed, but 61/63 images lacked intrinsic dimensions and responsive delivery was poor.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices/Inspector Issues and observed tooling output
checkOutcomes.evidence: Best-practices score was 0.58, Inspector Issues reported cookies, and a broken source map was logged.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected title/meta and Lighthouse SEO audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage and article have descriptive titles and meta descriptions; Lighthouse audits passed.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse SEO link audits, robots fetch, and viewport layout probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Robots permits indexing, but javascript:void anchors, generic link text, and absent viewport metadata fail the combined check.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected canonical/robots and fetched sitemap/robots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage/article canonical URLs, 200 discoverability fetches, permissive robots, and multiple sitemaps were present.

checkOutcomes.method: Parsed JSON-LD and Open Graph on home/article
checkOutcomes.evidence: Organization/WebSite and NewsArticle/Breadcrumb JSON-LD plus Open Graph accurately describe visible content.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran headers and cookies primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS passed, but CSP, nosniff, framing, referrer/permissions headers and secure cookie posture failed.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured trackers and HAR before consent choice
checkOutcomes.evidence: 57 third-party origins and 14 known tracker domains were active; 2.70MB of transfer was third-party.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected permission state and page-load UI
checkOutcomes.evidence: Geolocation/notification permission states remained prompt and no browser permission prompt appeared on load; no password-only primary auth flow was required in tested journeys.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran response-header, cookie, and Lighthouse third-party-cookie audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS exists, but framing/CSP/referrer/permissions protections are absent and third-party cookie issues are extensive.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared raw HTML with rendered DOM using discoverability primitive
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML contains 86% of homepage and 92% of article rendered words; neither page is a JS shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Exercised calculator controls and inspected overlays at mobile/desktop
checkOutcomes.evidence: Calculator state updates synchronously and modal UI remains within tested viewports without clipping.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected manifest, active service worker, and worker fetch/cache source
checkOutcomes.evidence: Manifest is standalone with start_url/icons; active service worker has fetch/cache handling and explicitly precaches /common/offline.html.

checkOutcomes.method: Requested a nonexistent route in browser and directly over HTTP
checkOutcomes.evidence: Unknown route yielded misleading homepage content in-browser and 403 directly, not an intentional recoverable 404.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected lang/dir and live stylesheet logical-property use
checkOutcomes.evidence: Language is declared, but no logical layout properties or explicit direction were found.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed rendered Indian currency/rate formatting and semantic article date
checkOutcomes.evidence: Rates consistently use ₹ and Indian grouping, and article dates are exposed in semantic time markup.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected visible and machine-readable publication time
checkOutcomes.evidence: Article time uses an unambiguous +05:30 ISO datetime and labels the visible value IST.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared consent UI with pre-choice network activity
checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent choices are visually equal, but tracker/HAR evidence shows extensive non-essential third-party activity before a choice.

checkOutcomes.method: Cleared calculator input after interaction and inspected invalid/alert state
checkOutcomes.evidence: Empty numeric input silently became ₹0 with no invalid state or accessible error.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected calculator controls, labels, types, ranges, and units
checkOutcomes.evidence: Core inputs use number types, associated labels, min/max constraints, a native select, and explicit unit controls.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon of representative templates and controls
checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription purchase, or required account flow exists in the audited public news/rates/calculator journeys.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative public journeys do not contain a commercial or required account transaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran image audit and HAR weight analysis
checkOutcomes.evidence: Most images lack dimensions/srcset, 30 are oversized, and 55 use legacy formats.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured idle page-load network and Lighthouse unused code
checkOutcomes.evidence: 183 requests, 47 scripts, and 570KiB estimated unused JS indicate substantial work unrelated to initial content.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured third-party requests/bytes and image delivery
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 152 requests and 2.70MB; images transfer 1.36MB.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected WebMCP registration and server-rendered affordances
checkOutcomes.evidence: Rich HTML/JSON-LD exists but no modelContext/WebMCP tools expose rate lookup or calculator actions.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected built-in AI surface and site tasks
checkOutcomes.evidence: Although browser LanguageModel/Summarizer APIs exist, this publisher does not present an authored on-device inference feature whose correctness can be judged.
checkOutcomes.reason: On-device inference is optional and no site-authored inference feature is offered.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared baseline and post heap summaries after repeated calculator tab/purity clicks
checkOutcomes.evidence: After repeated interaction, self size changed only +3,262 bytes (<0.01%); no meaningful retained growth was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured baseline heap summary on interactive calculator
checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline was ~630k nodes and 37.31MB self size, disproportionate for a small calculator surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared constructor/type populations before and after repeated interaction
checkOutcomes.evidence: No Detached* constructor appeared among retained populations and heap self size remained flat.

paths.description: Homepage and market/news dashboard; global navigation, consent, performance, privacy, discoverability, preferences, and responsive behavior.
News listing archetype; represents section/list templates and listing-to-detail navigation.
Current news article archetype; represents editorial detail, long reading, metadata, dates, and crawler visibility.
Gold rates data page; represents rate/data-rich utility templates.
Gold calculator primary interactive journey; controls, validation, accessibility, task completion, and repeated-interaction memory test.
Nonexistent route; HTTP and recovery-state resilience.

findings.summary: Consent dialog obscures every primary page on load
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a full-page dimming layer and modal before the user can read the homepage, article, rates, or calculator.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay non-essential consent UI until it is needed, keep content readable, and use a compact, accessible dialog with immediate equal-weight choices.

findings.summary: Mobile pages omit the viewport meta tag and render a scaled desktop canvas
findings.evidence: At a 360x800 emulation, layout reported hasViewportMeta=false and a 980-1003 CSS-pixel layout viewport, causing the browser to scale down desktop content.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and rework mobile breakpoints around the real device width.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible across primary navigation controls
findings.evidence: Programmatically focused links and buttons reported outline style none and no box-shadow; axe also found missing landmarks and heading-order errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible style, preserve logical focus order, and correct heading/landmark structure.

findings.summary: Failure and invalid states do not explain what happened or how to recover
findings.evidence: Clearing calculator weight produced ₹0 with no :invalid state, aria-invalid, or alert; a nonexistent URL rendered homepage content in-browser while direct HTTP returned 403, with no useful not-found recovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction, announce actionable errors, preserve valid input, and serve a clear 404 page with recovery links and the correct status.

findings.summary: Lab LCP is far outside the good threshold
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 13.9 s, Speed Index 7.1 s, and time-to-interactive 17.0 s; performance score was 0.64.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP dependency chain, prioritise the real LCP resource, and defer advertising/analytics until after critical content.

findings.summary: Third-party and unused JavaScript dominate delivery and main-thread cost
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 183 requests and 3.05 MB transferred, including 152 third-party requests and 2.70 MB third-party bytes; Lighthouse estimated 570 KiB unused JavaScript and TBT 210 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate analytics, gate ad auctions on consent/visibility, remove duplicate tags, and conditionally load non-critical scripts.

findings.summary: Icon controls and links lack accessible names
findings.evidence: axe found 10 unnamed buttons and 3 unnamed links on the homepage, plus 5 unnamed buttons and 3 unnamed links on the calculator.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every icon-only control a correct accessible name and ensure names match the action.

findings.summary: Key browser security headers and cookie protections are missing
findings.evidence: Headers audit found no CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. Cookie audit found 11 cookies flagged insecure and SameSite=None. HSTS was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors, strict referrer/permissions policies, and Secure cookies with the narrowest SameSite setting.

findings.summary: Tracking and advertising activate with an excessive third-party footprint
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 57 third-party origins and 14 known tracker domains; HAR captured 152 third-party requests and 2.70 MB before any consent choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Prevent non-essential requests until affirmative consent, minimise vendors, batch analytics, and document a strict third-party budget.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not stop auto-running animation
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() still reported a running 38,000 ms animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable auto-advance and non-essential animation inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: High-contrast support and baseline contrast are incomplete
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors treatment; axe found 3 homepage and 6 calculator contrast failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations and correct the failing text/control color pairs to WCAG AA.

findings.summary: Modal UI is built from custom divs rather than native dialog/popover primitives
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found four DIV role=dialog overlays and no native dialog or popover element.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal consent and popover for transient menus, preserving accessible labels and platform dismissal behavior.

findings.summary: Dense navigation, ad slots, and repeated market chrome compete with content
findings.evidence: Representative screenshots show two navigation/market rows, large advertisement slots, and dense card grids before or beside core content.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce persistent chrome, reserve fewer ad slots above the fold, and prioritise the article/calculator content.

findings.summary: Image markup wastes bytes and omits intrinsic sizing
findings.evidence: Image audit found 61/63 images without dimensions, 33 below-fold images not lazy, 30 oversized, 48 without srcset, and 55 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height, responsive srcset/sizes, modern formats, and lazy loading for below-fold images.

findings.summary: DevTools reports platform hygiene issues
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices score was 0.58 and Inspector Issues reported cookie problems; Chrome also reported an out-of-bounds source map during the run.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve DevTools Inspector Issues, fix source maps, and remove stale or misconfigured integrations.

findings.summary: Some navigation is not crawlable or descriptive
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found javascript:void(0) anchors for menu/city choices and nine generic “See more” links; the viewport meta tag is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons for actions, real href URLs for navigation, descriptive link text, and a valid viewport meta tag.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs do not produce a clear recoverable not-found state
findings.evidence: The browser received normal homepage content at a nonexistent route, while a direct request returned Cloudflare 403; neither presented a useful 404 explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Return 404 consistently and render a small recovery page with search and links to primary sections.

findings.summary: Calculator baseline memory footprint is high for a simple tool
findings.evidence: Heap summary contained about 630k nodes and 37.31 MB self size before interaction, driven by a large native/code footprint, despite the primary tool being a small calculator.
findings.suggestedFix: Load advertising and account integrations on demand, clear recurring work, and profile retained native/code allocations.

findings.summary: Route and state changes have no View Transition treatment
findings.evidence: Live CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations on this multi-page site.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for article/list navigation and same-document transitions for calculator state changes, with reduced-motion opt-out.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-state or progress guidance
findings.evidence: The article is several screens long, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or scroll-timeline/progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight article progress indicator or scroll-state-aware header using declarative CSS.

findings.summary: Reusable cards do not use container-level responsiveness
findings.evidence: Computed stylesheet inspection found no @container or container-type rules despite cards being reused in varied widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list regions containment and adapt them with size container queries.

findings.summary: Styles are not prepared for alternate writing directions
findings.evidence: The document declares language, but stylesheet inspection found no logical inline/block properties and no explicit dir.
findings.suggestedFix: Set dir where appropriate and replace directional layout properties with logical equivalents.

findings.summary: Public financial tools have no structured agent capability surface
findings.evidence: The page is server-rendered and richly structured, but the live probe found no WebMCP/modelContext registration for calculator or rate lookup actions.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose narrowly scoped, user-confirmed WebMCP tools for rate lookup and calculator actions while retaining normal HTML controls.
